audit_mode: Offline static comparison of captured permission metadata to local authorization code; no source contact or mutation.

field_permission_model.omission_semantics: Fields without an exception are read/write for the returned source profile metadata.

current_effective_model.model: Shared local session with no individual principal

implemented_global_safeguards.note: Reduces network exposure but does not identify or authorize a user.
All holders are indistinguishable and receive the same application access.
Protects direct database access but represents the server service, not a CRM end user.
Rejects unknown, formula, virtual, and globally read-only fields, but does not apply profile-specific field exceptions.
Delete is globally unavailable rather than allowed or denied according to the source profile.
The source transport is read-only; this is a data-safety boundary, not local user authorization.

identity_provider_decision.required_decision: Choose an identity provider and a stable local subject, then explicitly map each authorized local principal to one source user, profile, and role before enabling profile-sensitive reads or writes.

enforcement_boundary.reason: No verified local principal-to-source user, profile, and role mapping exists.
